Communication and Information Studies

Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

VU Communication and Information Studies examines language, media and communication. The Dutch Media en Journalistiek route combines media analysis, rhetoric, journalism practice, research methods and an individual thesis.

The published course allocation totals 180 EC, but a required course has a prerequisite that is absent from the route table. We show that allocation with the unresolved condition and withhold UCR alternatives pending clarification.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Media en Journalistiek; prerequisite pathway unresolved

The 180 EC shown is the published allocation, including 30 EC of open space. Discourse and Social Interaction requires prior Discourse Analysis, which is absent from this route table. An applicable replacement or exemption rule is needed before the pathway can be approved. The degree is not asserted to lack credits. The thesis and colloquium require all first- and second-year courses. The usual first-year threshold is 42 EC plus academic skills and the language test. Orientation modules and the language test carry no extra credit; attendance and approved choice rules apply.
